slides.headline: 5 AI myths that need to die
slides.sub: You've heard them all. Most of them are wrong.

slides.headline: AI will replace all jobs
slides.body: It won't. It replaces tasks. The people who learn to use it replace the people who don't.

slides.headline: More data always wins
slides.body: Garbage in, garbage out. A clean 10K dataset beats a noisy 10M one every single time.

slides.quote: The biggest risk isn't AI taking your job. It's you ignoring AI while someone else doesn't.
